name: gate_churchyard_iron_gate
source_description: Old wrought iron cemetery gate leaf with slender evenly spaced vertical square bars, modest pointed spear finials and a gently rising arched top toward the right latch side, three horizontal crossrails, restrained small curved scrolls only at top corners. Open transparent gaps between all bars, blackened oxidized iron, forged joints. Two hinge sleeves along left stile. No stone pillars.
